definitions.explanation: Describing speech, writing, or thought that lacks logical connection and is completely scattered or confused.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}だった。
{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}な{説明|せつめい}で{何|なに}も{分|わ}からなかった。
examples.english: The explanation was so disorganized that I didn't understand anything.

examples.japanese: {酔|よ}って{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}なことを{言|い}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He got drunk and started saying incoherent things.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO (FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM)

FORMATION:
{支離|しり} (scattered/apart) + {滅裂|めつれつ} (disjointed/chaotic)
- {支離|しり} itself means "scattered" or "disconnected"
- {滅裂|めつれつ} means "broken apart" or "in pieces"

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
・{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}な + noun ({話|はなし}, {説明|せつめい}, {文章|ぶんしょう})
・{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}だ/である - is incoherent

COLLOCATIONS:
・{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}な{話|はなし} - incoherent talk
・{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}な{文章|ぶんしょう} - incoherent writing
・{支離滅裂|しりめつれつ}な{論理|ろんり} - disjointed logic

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{滅茶苦茶|めちゃくちゃ} - messy, chaotic (more casual)
・{意味不明|いみふめい} - incomprehensible
